title: Phantom Blade Zero Physical Edition - PS5 Disc Is a 2027 Release
description: The PS5 physical edition of Phantom Blade Zero is confirmed for 2027, with no month, price or disc layout yet. What S-GAME has said, what a boxed release normally means, and how to play now if you want a disc.
keyword: phantom blade zero physical release, phantom blade zero physical copy, phantom blade zero ps5 disc, phantom blade zero physical edition

facts.label: Price
facts.value: Not announced for any boxed tier

sections.title: Where the Disc Version Stands
sections.content:
S-GAME announced on 21-22 October 2026, alongside the launch trailer, that physical PlayStation 5 editions are coming in 2027. Three tiers were named: a standard edition, a Deluxe edition, and an Ultimate edition in a collector's steelbook. Gematsu, 3DM and 4Gamer all carry the same three tiers, so this is a confirmed announcement rather than a rumour.

What was not announced is everything else: no month, no day, no price, no regional availability, and no statement on whether the disc carries the full build or a download stub. The launch itself was digital only, so anyone who wants a box is waiting, and the honest answer to "when can I buy a disc" is still "sometime in 2027".

sections.title: The Play-Asia Listing That Disappeared
sections.content:
Before the announcement, Play-Asia - a retailer that routinely stocks Asian imports - listed a physical edition and then removed the listing, reportedly after being told a physical version would not be available. That sequence is why the 2027 news should be read carefully rather than as a reversal: a boxed version appears to have been planned, cancelled, and then announced again for a different year.

The accurate summary of the record is that a physical release exists as an announcement now, and that nothing about it - date, contents, regions - has been published in enough detail to plan a purchase around.

sections.title: Why a Disc a Year Later
sections.content:
A 2027 date for a game that shipped digitally in 2026 is unusual but not inexplicable. Pressing discs requires a build to be frozen and certified, manufacturing slots to be booked, and retail distribution to be arranged per region - none of which the digital launch needed. A studio that prioritised a simultaneous global digital launch would naturally schedule the box afterwards.

It also means a 2027 disc would ship with a year of patches baked in or downloadable, which is usually the better version to own. That is the argument for waiting, if you are on the fence.

sections.title: If You Want to Play Before 2027
sections.content:
There is no way to get a disc now. The options are the PlayStation Store for PS5, or Steam and Epic for PC. Prices, regional differences and the Deluxe contents are on the buying guide, and the platform breakdown is on the platforms page.

One practical note for collectors: buying digital now does not disqualify you from buying the disc later, but it does mean paying twice if you want both. There is no announced upgrade or disc-for-digital programme.

sections.title: What Is Still Unknown
sections.content:
• Month, price and regional availability of the 2027 disc
  • Whether the disc build is complete or requires a download
  • What the boxed Deluxe and Ultimate tiers contain beyond the case and steelbook
  • Whether a physical PC release will follow

Those four items are the whole list of open questions. Anything else you read about the boxed version, including prices and box art, is speculation until S-GAME publishes it.

One detail worth keeping straight meanwhile: the digital Deluxe edition is a separate product from the boxed tiers and is on sale now. It contains the two outfits (Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form), a digital artbook and the digital soundtrack - see the buying guide for the full comparison.

sections.title: Physical Edition Questions
sections.content:
When is the Phantom Blade Zero physical edition out?

2027. S-GAME confirmed the year on 22 October 2026 and has not published a month or a day since.

Is there a physical copy available now?

No. The launch was digital only on PS5, Steam and Epic.

Will there be a collector's edition?

Yes - an Ultimate edition in a collector's steelbook was named in the announcement. Its contents have not been published.

Is a physical PC version coming?

Not announced. Only PS5 discs have been confirmed.
